hero.heading: About Us – Micro Hair Clinic
hero.subtitle: Restoring confidence – that's our real job.
bullets: Micro Hair Clinic is more than just a scalp micropigmentation studio.
It's where men and women come to once again recognize themselves in the mirror.
Our founder, Srđan Kostovski, is one of Europe’s most awarded SMP artists – but above all, someone who has personally experienced hair loss. And he understands.

sections.title: Srđan’s Story
text: "I started losing my hair early. It wasn't a sudden shock – more a slow feeling of losing a part of who I am. I didn't run away from it, but I wanted a solution that didn't feel like a 'solution'."
I learned about SMP, studied every result, observed every dot. And I decided – not just to undergo the treatment, but to master this skill properly."
Srđan completed his scalp micropigmentation training in Milan, and in 2015 opened the first SMP studio in the Balkans.
Today his work is recognized across Europe, and his treatments are the standard for natural SMP results.
bullets: Gold Award 2023 – Europe & UK’s Best SMP Artist (TeamMicro)
Best SMP Artist 2024 – SMP Connect Conference, Portugal
Top 10 SMP Artist in EU 2024 – TeamMicro selection
Micro Hair Clinic is officially listed among recommended SMP centers in Europe by TeamMicro

sections.title: Our Philosophy
text: In an industry where many focus on 'closing the client', we start by listening.
We don't offer treatment if it's not needed.
If there’s a chance your hair can recover naturally – we’ll tell you.
If you choose SMP, you get a treatment that looks:
customized to your face and style
with results that last for years
"We don’t draw hair – we restore identity." – Srđan Kostovski
